title: Bag of Bricks- Sand 03
descriptionHtml:
Sand — colour 03

A warm, dry neutral that reads as beach, desert or bare earth. Sand also makes an excellent quiet background — warm enough to feel deliberate, muted enough to let your subject hold the attention.

Works well with: Beige 09, Cream 20, Spring Yellow 04

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Sand bricks (colour 03) for Memobrick mosaics. A warm neutral for beaches, deserts and soft backgrounds that let your subject stand out.
